hints.title: Address Normalization
hints.text: Separate each address into its local and domain parts. Normalize the local part according to the filtering rules before recording unique entries.

hints.title: Rule-Based Local Filtering
hints.text: In the local part, discard everything from the first plus sign onwards, and eliminate all periods. Combine with the domain part and collect unique keys.

hints.title: Unique Set Accumulation
hints.text: Iterate through all strings. Split on @. For the local portion, take the substring before +, remove all dots, and append @ plus the domain. Place into a deduplicating container and return its size.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: maximum length of an address
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every raw email pair directly fails because differing representations can map to the exact same inbox.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Deduplicating through normalized strings takes linear time and auxiliary storage proportional to unique normalized addresses.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle string splitting, character filtering, and recognize that rules only apply to the local name.
complexity.notes: Domain names are kept strictly as-is; periods and pluses in domains have no special meaning.
